description: Fixed revenue per employee calculation bug by implementing UnifiedCompanyScoreLoader to ensure unified (merged JSON + Markdown) data is used before scoring

bug_details.issue: Revenue per employee showed €0 instead of €281K for Envision Digital
bug_details.root_cause: FinancialHealthScorer used raw JSON financials (line 93 of financial_health.py) instead of unified/merged data

key_features: Loads all companies with unified JSON + Markdown data
Graceful error handling with fallback to empty cache

integration_points.impact: All scoring requests now use unified data

verification.integration_tests: All 722 existing tests still pass (no regressions)
verification.manual_verification: Envision Digital now correctly shows €281K revenue per employee
verification.backward_compatibility: Fallback to repository if unified loader fails
